comment: File: speech/bundled-voices.json. Purpose: the English voice packed into the APK (ADR-012 rule, ADR-014). 'bundled' picks one entry; changing it is the whole swap once the phone blind rating is in. Archives come from sherpa-onnx's tts-models release and are checked against sha256 at build time. Never add Lessac/Blizzard-derived voices (lessac, amy, hfc_*, hi_IN rohan).
